name: Cashmere
long_description: Cashmere is a multisig solana wallet for enterprises to manage their digital assets. Instead of running their business from one person’s wallet, startups can use our wallet to securely manage their funds.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Shashank runs GTM engineering at Vanta. He was previously the co-founder and CEO of Cashmere. Before starting Cashmere, he was a software engineer at Amazon and SoFi. Shashank graduated from UCLA where he studied computer science.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Charlotte was previously the CTO of Cashmere. Prior to Cashmere, she worked as a software engineer at Tesla on music and video streaming in the vehicles. Charlotte graduated from UCLA with a degree in Computer Engineering.
